_comment: THE FOUR IN-SCOPE NATIONS, AS DATA. Read by the site (src/content/nations.js)
and by the cleaning scripts (data-pipeline/common.py), for the same reason
roster.json is shared: the two halves have to agree about which countries
this project covers, and a list written twice is a list that drifts.
lat/lon are approximate capital-city positions, hand-placed rather than
derived. All four are archipelagos and a computed centroid lands in open
water often enough to be wrong.
codes are the ISO-2 and ISO-3 forms the Pacific Data Hub exports use. Only
the pipeline reads these; the site matches on name.
short is the axis-label form, used where a band can be under 50px wide.
